watches.notes: Swiss Alps 100. 10/19/26 aa.com: MAIN $1,252 — the authoritative number. Expedia showed $770 'Basic' and a $890 Main estimate; BOTH WRONG by ~$362. Third failure of Expedia international pricing (cf. YYZ $517 vs $664). DO NOT extrapolate Main from Expedia on these routes — screen only, confirm on aa.com. SCREENING SOURCE: Google Flights, cabin "Economy (exclude basic)", tracking on — that filter is the only automated way to see Main rather than Basic. Expedia cannot do it: its filter_basic_economy parameter was tested both ways on 10/23/26 and ignored both times. The original $1,300 placeholder was within 4% and should not have been reset to $690. Target now $1,130 (~90% of the verified aa.com Main). Wed Aug 11 return. Expedia showed price parity with the Aug 14 row and a worse routing, but that comparison is unverified — re-check both dates on aa.com. | PERSONAL TRIP — points preferred, but 10/19/26 award = 138,500 miles vs $1,252 cash = 0.90 cpp, and ~0.75 cpp after likely BA surcharges. Far below the 2.0 line: PAY CASH. 138.5k at 2.0 cpp is ~$2,770 of value elsewhere, so redeeming here destroys ~$1,500. 138.5k = AA dynamic pricing with NO saver space open, not the trip's true mileage cost. AWARD TRIGGER: take the award only if saver opens at <= ~62,600 miles (or ~50,000 after a $250 surcharge). Watch award space alongside cash — peak-August Europe saver does open in waves.

NOT a flight — booking reminder, no fare search. Eurostar London→Lille + TGV Lille→Reims; car pickup Reims (or CDG fallback). 10/19 check: Eurostar inventory currently extends only to 17 Mar 2027, so 29 Jun 2027 is NOT yet bookable — the old ~Oct 2026 estimate was too early. Horizon is ~360 days but actual release lags, and Eurostar's cheapest fares typically surface 4–5 months out, i.e. Feb–Mar 2027. Window start moved to 1/15/27 to catch the release.
